alt: Three PDFs in pdf_files/ (the Transformer and BERT papers and RFC 8259) are converted by docling on a GPU runner from a laid-out page into Markdown with headings such as "## 3.2 Attention", split into 2000-character chunks, embedded with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 and stored as rows in the pdf_embeddings table in Postgres; replacing rfc8259.pdf re-parses only that file, and the query "what is attention?" returns the Transformer paper's passage "An attention function can be described as mapping a query and a set of key-value pairs to an output".

run.note: Configure and install (docling pulls in the PDF parser)
